map.：算法：点积 a·b = ax·bx + ay·by；a 在 b 上的投影长度（: : algorithm: dot product a.b = ax*bx + ay*by; a's projection length on b (signed) = a.b / |b|, |b| = sqrt(bx^2+by^2), e.g., b=(3,4) gives |b|=5. Positive projection means the component same direction as b, negative means opposite. Requires b nonzero.
map.：例：a=(3,4)、b=(1,0) → a·b=3、|b|=1.000、投影=: : example: a=(3,4), b=(1,0) -> a.b=3, |b|=1.000, projection=3.000 (i.e., a's projection on the x-axis equals its x component). If a=(1,2), b=(3,4) -> a.b=11, |b|=5.000, projection=2.200; dot product > 0 means the angle between the two vectors is acute.
